title: NAVSUP FLC Pearl Harbor and 647th Logistics Readiness Squadron Support NASA's SpaceX Crew-1 Launch
description: 201120-N-TA290-1001 HONOLULU (November 20, 2020) The 647th Logistics Readiness Squadron (LRS), Combat Mobility Flight supports the Guardian Angel operation for NASA's SpaceX Crew-1 launch on November 15, 2020. The 647th LRS provides upload and download support of 8 tons of equipment needed for the Guardian Angel operation, including: medical equipment, boats, and jet skis required for open water rescues to be used by pararescuemen in case of emergency. The 647th LRS is partnered with Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Fleet Logistics Center (FLC) Pearl Harbor on Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam. (U.S. Navy video by Daniel Mayberry/Released)

transcript.text: Five. Four. Three. Two. One. Zero.  Ignition. Lift-off of the Falcon-9
and crew Dragon! Go NASA! Go SpaceX! God speed! We are the 647 Logistics Readiness Squadron. We
support the Guardian Angel mission by mobilizing  the capsule recovery package, consisting of
eight tons of rescue equipment, including medical  gear, boats, and jet skis for open water rescue.
Guardian Angel is part of the combat  search and rescue missions. We're here
to support NASA and SpaceX missions  to the International Space Station.
From all of us at NASA, we'd like to give a big  thanks the 647th Logistics Readiness Squadron
and to Naval Supply Fleet  Logistic Center Pearl Harbor.
Thank you for supporting  the Guardian Angel mission.
With our mission partners at the  647th Logistics Readiness Squadron,
NAVSUP FLC Pearl Harbor supports the fleet,  the flight line, and now the final frontier!
